g.text: JP1 fitted at reset: SCI boot mode over the CP2102N (SCI9). Firmware: stop the main oscillator (MOSCCR.MOSTP = 1),

g.desc: JP1 fitted at reset: SCI boot mode over the CP2102N (SCI9). Firmware: stop the main oscillator (MOSCCR.MOSTP = 1),

g.text: so P212/P213 serve as SCI1 on D0/D1; sub-clock drive Standard CL (SOMCR.SODRV = 00).

g.desc: so P212/P213 serve as SCI1 on D0/D1; sub-clock drive Standard CL (SOMCR.SODRV = 00).
